new.rationale: Horror-escape loops hold the best median Up-and-Coming percentile today (85, n=4) with two games at 11-15 days near the top, while MM2 of The Locust (16 days) sits near the bottom. Needs several weeks of uc_pos trajectories by age for horror_escape games to confirm the rise-and-fade shape.

qualitative_updates.note: Entry counts are unchanged from yesterday (uc->tt 9 at 1 day, tt->mp 10 at 2 days, uc->te 6 at 1 day); no new evidence either way.

The monetization side holds ('Egg' r=-0.58, 'Steal' r=-0.40 on Top Earning), but the popularity side weakened: steal_defend_base sits at the 36th Up-and-Coming percentile and H-uc-002 fell to 46%. Pets/eggs still lead Top Trending positions (+0.40).
Party loops hold a median 72nd percentile on Top Trending momentum but only 37th on Top Earning efficiency, which fits the idea.
